# IEIE v9 — paired comparisons, v8fix test_full (generated by paper/make_tables_v8fix.py; do not edit by hand)

- Data: fastMRI brain multicoil test_full, 558 volumes / 8,852 slices, R=4. Each model trained once (seed 1); best checkpoint selected on the official validation split (validation batches 0–2, 1,378 volumes / 21,842 slices).
- Reference model = ETER-net. Primary pairs: SS2D(controlled) − ETER-net, U-Net only − ETER-net. Secondary: SS2D(controlled) − U-Net only.
- Δ = A − B per volume (mean of paired per-volume differences). "A better" = A higher for SSIM/PSNR, lower for nMSE; ties are not counted. p = volume-level two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (`scipy.stats.wilcoxon(Δ)`, same call as `v8_eter_pure/eval_v8fix_official_compare.py`).
- Slice-level better counts use the per-slice CSV (8,852 slices) for metrics that exist per slice; official PSNR/nMSE are volume-pooled and the official SSIM map inside/outside the brain exists only per volume (n/a).
- nMSE differences are in % (fraction × 100). Each model was trained once, so p reflects variation across test volumes only, not across training runs.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| PSNR (dB) inside the brain mask | 34.78±1.86 | 34.69±1.84 | +0.097366 | +0.10 | 482/558 (86.4%) | 6,326/8,852 (71.5%) | 3.9e-61 (p<0.001) |
| nMSE (%) inside the brain mask | 0.381±0.414 | 0.388±0.434 | −0.0072352 | −0.007 | 486/558 (87.1%) | 6,326/8,852 (71.5%) | 2.1e-59 (p<0.001) |

| nMSE (%), fastMRI official definition (volume-pooled) | 2.815±0.926 | 2.303±0.811 | +0.5120023 | +0.512 | 114/558 (20.4%) | n/a | 2.6e-62 (p<0.001) |
